description: Get a complete scenario workflow with every step expanded (phase, description, prompt text). Variables are substituted across all steps. Use this when the user describes a full engagement (incident, audit, hunt) rather than a single task.

id.description: Scenario id (web-app-pentest, incident-response, cloud-audit, bug-bounty-recon, compliance-audit, threat-hunting, ai-security).

variables.description: Object mapping variable name to value. See cybersec_list_scenarios for each scenario's expected variables.

name: cybersec_get_scenario
